findings.message: BigQuery refuses `v.started_at > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)`: it doesn't convert between DATETIME and TIMESTAMP to compare them, so the query fails before it reads anything.
findings.fix: Convert one side: `DATETIME(TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))` reads the timestamp in UTC, and `TIMESTAMP(v.started_at)` reads the datetime as UTC.
